q: 我昨天吃___两片药。
en: I took two tablets yesterday.

q: 医生昨天给他开___三天的药。
en: The doctor prescribed him three days' worth of medicine yesterday.

q: 昨天夜里下___一场大雪，今天地上全是白的。
en: A heavy snow fell last night, and today the ground is all white.

q: 昨天他发烧，一口气喝___三大杯热水，然后就睡了。
en: Yesterday he had a fever; he downed three big glasses of hot water in one go and then went to sleep.

q: 今天早上小李跑___五公里，现在腿很疼。
en: Xiao Li ran five kilometres this morning and his legs hurt now.

q: 昨天我买___那瓶退烧药，可是还没吃。
en: I bought that bottle of fever medicine yesterday, but I have not taken it yet.

q: 昨天还很热，今天天气冷___。
en: It was still hot yesterday, but it has turned cold today.

q: 春天到___，花都开了。
en: Spring has arrived, and the flowers are all in bloom.

q: 他的感冒好___，不用再吃药了。
en: His cold has cleared up; he does not need to take medicine any more.

q: 快要下雪___，你出门别忘了戴帽子。
en: It's about to snow, so don't forget your hat when you go out.

q: 经过一个星期的治疗，他的咳嗽终于好___。
en: After a week of treatment, his cough has finally cleared up.

q: 树叶已经黄___，一阵风吹来就掉了。
en: The leaves have already turned yellow; one gust of wind and they fall.

q: 雨停___，我们出去走走吧。
en: The rain has stopped; let's go out for a walk.

q: 天越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也多___。
en: It's getting colder and colder, and there are more patients with colds in the hospital too.

q: 孩子的烧退___，现在不烫了。
en: The child's fever has gone down; he isn't hot to the touch any more.

q: 这场雨都下了三天___，还是没有停的意思。
en: It has been raining for three whole days and shows no sign of stopping.

q: 他已经发烧了三天___，一直没退，今天一定得去医院。
en: He has already had a fever for three days and it has not gone down; he has to go to the hospital today.

q: 去年冬天我感冒了两个星期___，后来才好。
en: Last winter I had a cold for two weeks before I got better.

q: 他在医院里住___半个月___，上个星期才回家。
en: He spent half a month in hospital and only came home last week.

q: 到现在他已经跑了五公里___，还不想停下来。
en: By now he has already run five kilometres and still does not want to stop.

q: 小时候我在乡下住___十年___，所以特别喜欢那里的空气。
en: I lived in the countryside for ten years as a child, so I especially like the air there.

q: 这个冬天已经下了五场雪___，路上的雪还没化完。
en: This winter it has already snowed five times, and the snow on the road has not all melted yet.

q: 他昨晚吃___两片药就睡了。
en: Last night he took two tablets and went to sleep.

q: 小王昨天吃___那两片退烧药就躺下了。
en: Xiao Wang took those two fever tablets yesterday and lay down.

q: 我洗___三次手，才开始吃饭。
en: I washed my hands three times before I started eating.

q: 你喝___这两杯热水，再休息一会儿吧。
en: Drink these two cups of hot water first, then rest for a while.

q: 吃___饭，我们去公园散步。
en: After we eat, let's go for a walk in the park.

q: 你先量___体温，再决定要不要吃药。
en: Take your temperature first, then decide whether to take medicine.

q: 等天气暖和___，我们就带孩子去公园放风筝。
en: Once the weather warms up, we will take the children to the park to fly kites.

q: 我昨晚喝___那碗姜汤，出___一身汗，今天早上感觉好多了。
en: Last night I drank that bowl of ginger soup and broke into a sweat; this morning I feel much better.

q: 我每天早上喝___一杯热水。
en: I drink a cup of hot water every morning.

q: 小时候妈妈经常给我煮___姜汤。
en: When I was little, my mum often made me ginger soup.

q: 夏天他常常喝___冰水，所以总是拉肚子。
en: In summer he often drinks iced water, so he often has an upset stomach.

q: 那几年每到秋天，奶奶都要腌___很多萝卜，一直吃到春天。
en: In those years, every autumn Grandma would pickle lots of radishes, and we ate them until spring.

q: 我们一般晚上八点吃___药。
en: We usually take our medicine at eight in the evening.

q: 我昨天没吃___早饭。
en: I didn't have breakfast yesterday.

q: 医生让我吃药，可是我没吃___那些药。
en: The doctor told me to take medicine, but I didn't take those pills.

q: 昨天一整天都没下___雨，天气特别好。
en: It did not rain all day yesterday, and the weather was great.

q: 虽然医生让他多休息，但是他昨天一点儿也没休息___。
en: Although the doctor told him to rest more, he did not rest at all yesterday.

q: 感冒的时候他没去___学校，一直在家休息。
en: When he had a cold he did not go to school and stayed home to rest.

q: 去年冬天北京很冷___，我每天都穿羽绒服。
en: Last winter Beijing was very cold, and I wore a down jacket every day.

q: 我小时候很怕___打针，每次都哭。
en: When I was little I was very afraid of injections and cried every time.

q: 医生昨天觉得___我的病不严重，让我回家休息。
en: The doctor thought my illness wasn't serious and sent me home to rest.

q: 昨天下午公园里有___很多人，大家都在晒太阳。
en: There were lots of people in the park yesterday afternoon, all sunning themselves.

q: 他以前是___我们学校最好的游泳运动员，现在腿受伤了。
en: He used to be the best swimmer at our school, but now his leg is injured.

q: 我那时候很喜欢___夏天，因为可以天天游泳。
en: Back then I really liked summer, because I could swim every day.

q: 今天太热___，我们别出去了。
en: It's too hot today; let's not go out.

q: 这种药太苦___，孩子不愿意吃。
en: This medicine is too bitter; the child won't take it.

q: 太冷___的天气我不想出门。
en: I don't want to go out in weather that is too cold.

q: 医生说你的身体太弱___，必须多休息。
en: The doctor says your body is too weak and you must rest more.

q: 我头不疼___，可以去上课了。
en: My head does not hurt any more; I can go to class now.

q: 雨太大了，我们不去爬山___。
en: The rain is too heavy; we're not going hiking after all.

q: 他已经戒烟了，现在不抽烟___。
en: He has quit smoking and doesn't smoke any more.

q: 退烧药都吃完了，家里没有药___。
en: The fever medicine is all gone; there is no medicine left in the house.

q: 天太冷了，爷爷说他今天不想出门___。
en: It's so cold that Grandpa says he doesn't want to go out today after all.
